During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] '''attacked''' the Republic's [[Ardis Outpost]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Despite the surprise ambush, Republic reinforcements were able to drive off the Imperial forces and save the station.<ref name="TOR" />
